svg.title: Four Decisions Before Publishing an Offer
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-preflight-risk-decisions; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Decisions Before Publishing an Offer; subtitle: Any failed check stops the affected transaction until corrected.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Apply requirements by event location, customer location, seller activity, and contract. Federal rules do not replace state licensing, venue restrictions, or exchange-specific obligations.; caption: Document the answer and evidence for each branch. Strong demand cannot cure defective acquisition rights, unlawful pricing, unfunded refunds, or duplicate inventory.; stages: label: Acquisition and resale authority; value: Pass with evidence; otherwise reject; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Check 15 U.S.C. §45c acquisition restrictions and retain purchase provenance. Verify sponsor resale permission, suite subdivision rights, and event transfer conditions. Reject covered circumvention and inventory without supportable authority.; label: Licensing and total price; value: Pass after jurisdiction-specific checks; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Apply relevant reseller licensing, including New York Arts and Cultural Affairs Law Article 25 when applicable. Under 16 CFR §§464.2–464.3, display required total pricing and avoid fee misrepresentations; account separately for permitted exclusions and required prepayment disclosures.; label: Liquidity and disruption capacity; value: Pass only with funded stress coverage; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Model rainout, postponement, injury-driven markdown, and cancellation. Stress a 30-day payout extension and supplier refund arriving after customer reimbursement. If available cash cannot fund obligations, reduce position size or decline the purchase.; label: Inventory lock and delivery; value: Pass tested synchronization; otherwise pause; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Test POS hold propagation, stale-feed alerts, transfer eligibility, and emergency delisting across active channels. Stress a replacement charge equal to 200% of sale value where contract terms support it; this is not a universal exchange penalty.
